The recent Reddit spike likely reflects bargain hunters and oversold-bounce traders, not a fundamental turnaround. Stocktwits bulls are vocal, but many are short-term traders looking for a quick reversal. The bear case remains heavy: margin pressure, free-cash-flow concerns, and doubts about Intel's foundry strategy. If you are considering Intel, understand that the community is split between "too cheap to ignore" and "value trap." The next earnings report and any foundry customer announcements will be critical. Until then, expect volatility and plenty of memes.
